shared_elements: low-relief figures carved on a flat stone face
animals oriented in the same direction (facing right)
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic one of quadrupeds rendered in profile in low relief facing the same direction, which almost any relief tradition could produce independently. B shows a structured processional scene with human figures leading and following a humped camel, framed above and below by rosette bands, whereas A shows isolated, boldly schematic animals stacked on an unframed pillar face with no human figures or ornamental borders at all.
